summary.text: Sam McKenzie is a Democratic state representative who has represented Tennessee House of Representatives District 15 since November 3, 2020, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Sam McKenzie was born in Knoxville, Tennessee, and graduated from Austin-East High School.
He earned a B.S. in physics from Fisk University and an M.S. in physics from the University of Memphis, and his career experience includes working with Oak Ridge National Laboratory.
McKenzie succeeded Rick Staples in the District 15 seat.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Education Administration, House Ethics, Finance, Ways, and Means, and Local Government committees.
